::: {#exr-fox-tell-dress}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: C13-hzqdf
dyn1 <- makeODE(dy ~ 2, dx ~ 2-y)
sol1a <- integrateODE(dyn1, domain(t=0:2), x = 0, y =0)
sol1b <- integrateODE(dyn1, domain(t=0:2), x = 2, y =1)

dyn2 <- makeODE(dy ~ x, dx ~ x + 2-y)
sol2a <- integrateODE(dyn2, domain(t=0:1.6), x = 1, y =1)
sol2b <- integrateODE(dyn2, domain(t=0:.6), x = 2, y =0)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: C13-cqrtk
flow_field(dyn1, domain(x = 0:5, y = 0:5)) |>
  traj_plot(x(t) ~ y(t), sol1a, color = "blue", nt=0, inherit=FALSE, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.5) |>
  traj_plot(x(t) ~ y(t), sol1b, color = "green", nt=0, inherit=FALSE, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.5) |>
  traj_plot(x(t) ~ y(t), sol2a, color = "tomato", nt=0, inherit=FALSE, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.5) |>
  traj_plot(x(t) ~ y(t), sol2b, color = "gray", nt=0, inherit=FALSE, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.75) |>
  gf_refine(coord_fixed()) |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal(base_size = 16))
```

1. `r devoirs3::devoirs_TF(FALSE, label = "traj-ftd-1-lx")` For the flow shown above, [red]{style="color: red;"} is a trajectory.

2. `r devoirs3::devoirs_TF(TRUE, label = "traj-ftd-2-l7y")` For the flow shown above, [green]{style="color: green;"} is a trajectory.

3. `r devoirs3::devoirs_TF(FALSE, label = "traj-ftd-3-kw")` For the flow shown above, [red]{style="color: red;"} is a trajectory.

4. `r devoirs3::devoirs_TF(FALSE, label = "traj-ftd-3-luy")` For the flow shown above, [gray]{style="color: darkgray;"} is a trajectory.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: C13-pypey
traj_plot(x(t) ~ t, sol1b) |> 
  gf_labs(x = "t", y = "??", subtitle="Time series 1")
```

    a. [gray-x]{style="color: darkgray;"}
    b. [gray-y]{style="color: darkgray;"}
    c. [red-x]{style="color: red;"}
    d. [red-y]{style="color: red;"}
    e. [green-x]{style="color: green;"}
